view.aria: Waveform with pitch curves, target {{target}}. Drag the target line to change the note, click to seek.

harm.title: Harmonic ceilings
harm.hint: Harmonic ceilings · drag a node down · double-click resets
harm.empty: Process a sample to see its harmonics

praat_soft.label: PSOLA (Praat) Soft
praat_soft.info: Natural + smooth retune using Praat overlap-add. Requires praat-parselmouth.

world_soft.label: WORLD Soft (Retune)
world_soft.info: Smooth retune with amount/speed/vibrato controls (WORLD vocoder).

world_hard.label: WORLD Hard (Flatten)
world_hard.info: Hard snap to the target note for the most robotic/locked sound (WORLD vocoder).

world_vt.label: WORLD VT (Vocal Tract)
world_vt.info: WORLD vocoder with pitch-adaptive vocal tract modeling. Adjusts formant structure based on pitch change for natural-sounding results.

world_hnm.label: WORLD HNM (Harmonic)
world_hnm.info: Harmonic resynthesis with vocal tract modeling. Cleanest harmonics, best for large pitch shifts.

sine_spectral.label: Sinusoidal (Spectral)
sine_spectral.info: Tracks and shifts individual harmonics with spectral envelope preservation. Best for clean tonal sources.

stft_pitchshift.label: STFT Spectral (Phase Vocoder)
stft_pitchshift.info: STFT phase vocoder with cepstral formant preservation. Clean, natural-sounding pitch shift.

audiotsm_wsola.label: WSOLA
audiotsm_wsola.info: Crisp in quality and the best for general speech audio. Can sound robotic if over-done.

audiotsm_ola.label: OLA
audiotsm_ola.info: Overlap-add time stretching. Simple and fast.

audiotsm_phasevocoder.label: Phase Vocoder
audiotsm_phasevocoder.info: Smoother and more ideal under x2 stretching

rubberband_default_engine_faster.label: Rubber Band (Faster)
rubberband_default_engine_faster.info: Faster Rubber Band engine. Good balance of speed and quality.

rubberband_percussive_engine_finer.label: Rubber Band Percussive
rubberband_percussive_engine_finer.info: Deals with transients and artifact removal a lot better than Rubber Band Default.

tdpsola.label: TD-PSOLA
tdpsola.info: Fallback stretcher that works without audiotsm/rubberband (can be slower).

target.title: Target
target.hint: Ctrl+↑/↓ semitone · Ctrl+Shift+↑/↓ octave · drag the target line on the waveform

voicing.title: Voicing
voicing.help: Force makes every frame voiced; Strict keeps unvoiced frames unvoiced; Dilate grows the voiced regions by 3 frames. WORLD modes only.

stretch.title: Stretch
stretch.warn_over_2: Above 2× expect artifacts; the sample may sound fake.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.limiter_help: Opens the ceiling editor under the waveform.

controls.reset_hint: Double-click any control to reset it. ● marks a non-default value.

ms.title: Multisample / SFZ
ms.invalid_range: Low note must not be above the high note
ms.loop_help: Uses the loop settings under Advanced.
ms.output_help: One WAV per note, root note and loop points embedded.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.theme_help: One dark and one light theme.
prefs.warmup_help: Pre-initialises the DSP so the first process is faster.
